body:
## What it is

WeGoTrip sells this as a self-guided audio tour in Berlin, Germany. The listing gives its length as 2 hours, over a route of about 5 km. It starts at Madame Tussauds Berlin, Madame Tussauds Berlin Müzesi, Unter den Linden, Berlin, Germany. An entry ticket is part of the package; the listing includes: Entrance ticket to Madame Tussauds Berlin. The tour plays in the WeGoTrip app on your own phone.

## How WeGoTrip describes it

> Immerse yourself in the capital of Germany with a ticket included to Madame Tussauds, kicking off a self-narrated exploration of time-honored landmarks and symbolic monuments. (!) Note that while the tour includes an entrance ticket to Madame Tussauds, an audio guide inside the museum is not provided.
>
> The self-guided route takes a deep dive into Berlin's diverse culture, offering a detailed exploration from Unter den Linden Street's tree-lined grandeur to the modernity meshing with history at the Reichstag Building. The tour begins outside the entertaining wax figures of Madame Tussauds and concludes at the imposing Red City Hall, after traversing the symbolic Brandenburg Gate and the lush greenery of Tiergarten Park.
>
> Listeners will experience a blend of sorrow and triumph as they stand before the poignant Memorial to the Murdered Jews of Europe and the majestic Berlin Cathedral, reflecting on the resilience of a city reborn from its turbulent history. The audio journey promises not just historical insights but an intimate acquaintance with the very soul of Berlin.

On 13 November 2026, WeGoTrip's product data listed it from €39.04. It was rated 4.7 out of 5 from 268 ratings and 104 written reviews. The final price is shown at WeGoTrip's checkout.

## Where this page comes from

This page was built on 13 November 2026 from WeGoTrip's partner data, the product information WeGoTrip gives its affiliates. We have not taken this tour ourselves, so check the listing for anything that matters to you before you book.
